terms.note: MCP primitive: an action the model chooses and calls. The wire identifiers `tools/call` and `tools/list` and any code identifiers stay in Latin script inside code font; not the colloquial 툴. Provisional pending native review.

MCP primitive: read-only data the application reads. `resources/read` and other identifiers stay Latin in code font. Provisional pending native review; 자원 is the general system-resources word and is avoided here.
Both the MCP primitive (a message template a person invokes) and the general LLM sense; 프롬프트 in both. Provisional pending native review.
MCP feature where the server asks the client's model for a completion; not the statistics sense (표본 추출). Provisional pending native review.

Filesystem locations the client exposes. No plural marker (write 루트, not 루트들); the `roots/list` identifier stays Latin. Target provisional pending native review; 뿌리 (the botanical root) is never correct here.

The server asking the user for input through the client. Write 사용자 입력 요청(elicitation) at the first occurrence on a page, 사용자 입력 요청 alone afterwards. Compounds: form elicitation → 폼 입력 요청, URL-mode elicitation → URL 모드 입력 요청, push elicitation → 푸시 입력 요청. An "elicitation request" is just 사용자 입력 요청, never 사용자 입력 요청 요청. The verb "elicit" in prose is 사용자에게 입력을 요청하다; `ctx.elicit(...)` and `elicitation/create` stay code. Not the transliteration 엘리시테이션, which carries no meaning for Korean readers, and not 유도, which reads as nudging the user. Native review (#3732).

What a client or server declares that it supports, negotiated when the connection starts ("capability negotiation" → 지원 기능 협상). Plain 기능 stays reserved for "feature", so the two remain distinct even in adjacent sentences: "A callback is a capability" → 콜백 등록이 곧 지원 기능 선언. Not 역량 or 능력; the `capabilities` wire field and `client.server_capabilities` stay Latin in code. Native review (#3732).

The countable, named connection mechanism (stdio 트랜스포트, 인메모리 트랜스포트) and the `Transport` protocol name in code. Prose describing the generic idea of how messages are carried may say 전송 방식 without implying a separate term. Provisional pending native review; 운송/수송 (freight transport) are never correct.
Standard loanword; `ctx.session` and other identifiers stay code. Provisional pending native review.
The function registered for a tool, resource or prompt. 핸들러 rather than 처리기, to match modern Korean developer docs and the code vocabulary. Provisional pending native review.
Dependency-injection sense ("dependency injection" → 의존성 주입); a package dependency in installation contexts is also 의존성. Provisional pending native review; 종속성 is the competing house style.
The protocol role. The `Client` and `ClientSession` class names stay Latin in code font (see keep list). Provisional pending native review; 고객 means a customer and is never correct here.
The protocol role. The `MCPServer` and `Server` class names stay Latin in code font (see keep list). Provisional pending native review.

"MCP host" is the application that embeds a client (a desktop assistant, an editor); the corpus also says "ASGI host" for the app that serves an ASGI app — 호스트 covers both. Provisional pending native review.
A JSON-RPC or HTTP request; the verb "to request" is 요청하다. Not the transliteration 리퀘스트. Provisional pending native review.
A JSON-RPC or HTTP response; not the transliteration 리스폰스. Provisional pending native review.

The "context provided to a model" sense (as in Model Context Protocol). The `Context` class and `ctx` are identifiers and stay Latin (see keep list). The everyday idiom "in this context" is not this term and may be recast (이 경우, 여기서는). Provisional pending native review; 맥락 is the competing rendering for the general word.
Protocol notifications (`notifications/...` identifiers stay Latin); "send a notification" → 알림을 보내다; not 통지. Provisional pending native review.
The SDK's `Resolve(...)`-annotated parameter resolvers. Provisional pending native review; 해석기 (parser/interpreter) and 해결자 are avoided.

Security sense: authorization → 인가 (인가 서버 for authorization server, 인가 코드 for authorization code), distinct from authentication → 인증. The `Authorization` HTTP header and code identifiers stay Latin. Provisional pending native review — 승인 and 권한 부여 are competing renderings to confirm against.

Advisory status: still works but discouraged. First occurrence on a page may add the original: 지원 중단 예정(deprecated). Never shorten it to 지원 중단, which reads as already unsupported: "deprecation warning" → 지원 중단 예정 경고. When a protocol revision marks the point of deprecation, write 사양부터: "deprecated at `2026-07-28`" → `2026-07-28` 사양부터 지원 중단 예정, never `2026-07-28`에서, which reads as a calendar date. "Removed" is a different word (제거됨); the corpus contrasts the two, so never render deprecated as 폐기됨 or 제거됨. Native review (#3732).
A network round trip; "multi-round-trip requests" → 다중 왕복 요청; not the transliteration 라운드 트립. Provisional pending native review.

Keep the English word in Korean prose (lifespan 함수, 호스트 앱의 lifespan), matching the `lifespan=` parameter it names. Provisional pending native review — 수명 주기 was rejected because it collides with "lifecycle" (생명 주기).

An era is a group of protocol revisions, not a period of time, so it gets no Korean noun of its own: name the versions instead. 2025-era and handshake-era → `2025-11-25` 이하 버전; 2026-era and modern era → `2026-07-28`; pre-2026 → `2026-07-28` 이전 버전; a generic "era" ("any era of server", "MCP has two eras") → 프로토콜 버전. Never a time word: not -년대 (a decade, so 2025년대 is not Korean), 시대, 시절 or 세대. Native review (#3732).

terms.source: wire (on the wire, wire name, wire format)
terms.note: No single noun; render by context. On or across the wire → 실제로 주고받는 메시지에서; a wire name, key or format → 프로토콜상 이름 / 키 / 형식; the wire as the channel (stdout under stdio) → 통신 채널; the verb "wire" (to connect) → 연결하다. Never the transliteration 와이어. Native review (#3732).
A request the server sends to the client (sampling, elicitation, roots). Not 서버 시작 요청, which reads as a request to start the server, and not 서버 주도. Native review (#3732).
The argument-completion primitive and the title of its page; the same rendering in link text pointing to that page. `completion/complete` stays code. Native review (#3732).

The text an LLM produces ("sampling asks the client's model for a completion"). Keep the English word in Korean prose, as with lifespan. Not 완성, 완성 결과 or 컴플리션; the Completions primitive is the separate entry above (자동 완성). Native review (#3732).
OAuth and identity providers: keep the English word in Korean prose (OAuth provider, identity provider), as with lifespan. Not 프로바이더 or 공급자. Native review (#3732).
A function, tool or prompt argument; matches the Korean glossary of the Python documentation (docs.python.org/ko/3/glossary.html). Not 인수. Native review (#3732).
A function or tool parameter; matches the Korean glossary of the Python documentation. Not 파라미터. Native review (#3732).
Type annotations and tool annotations; matches the Korean glossary of the Python documentation. Not 애너테이션. Native review (#3732).
Matches the Korean glossary of the Python documentation; not left in Latin script in prose. Native review (#3732).
The MCP specification; one rendering everywhere, not 명세 on some pages. Native review (#3732).

The nav section that opens the guide, and the title of its index page. "First steps" is a separate page inside that section (첫걸음), so the two need distinct renderings or the sidebar shows the same title twice. Provisional pending native review. 첫 단계 is the alternative for the page.
The tutorial page inside the "Get started" section; never reuse this rendering for the section itself (see that entry). Provisional pending native review.
Recurring section heading that closes most pages; one rendering everywhere, not 요약 on some pages and 정리 on others. Provisional pending native review.
Recurring section heading above a runnable example; one rendering everywhere, with this spacing (해 보기), not 실행해 보기 or 사용해 보기 on some pages. Provisional pending native review.
